subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ignoramus
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Stupid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ignoramus"** means a person who is ignorant or lacks knowledge. (मूर्ख व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his arrogance, he was an ignoramus when it came to basic scientific facts.
 
 
 
• **"Stupid"** refers to a person who shows a lack of intelligence or common sense. (मूर्ख)
 
 
• **Example:** It was stupid of him to ignore the warning signs and go hiking in bad weather.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Ignoramus'** is **'Stupid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Stupid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deceitful** (धोखेबाज़): Misleading or dishonest.
 
 
• **Example:** His deceitful behavior caused a lot of mistrust among his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Playful** (चंचल): Full of fun and high spirits.
 
 
• **Example:** The kittens were playful and chased each other around the room.
 
 
 
• **Cautious** (सावधान): Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
 
 
• **Example:** She was cautious when crossing the busy street.
 
 

16d:Taf1,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**
